name: Praia do Pontal
scoreNote: Calm bay water (Baía do Pontal), not ocean surf.
note: Baía do Pontal. There are NO walkable bay beaches left — the port (built 1970s) took them; Av. Soares Lopes itself was beachfront before that. So this is not a scored beach: buildings[] stays empty permanently. Bay-side condos (Pontal Park, Baia Marina, Reserva Sapetinga, Atlantis) advertise 'vista mar' (bay view) but are scored by distance to the nearest OCEAN beach, not to the bay. Their real ocean access (highway crossings, gated blocks, the ~300m peninsula crossing) is unmapped field work — left curated for now. Line kept only as a map reference.
